profile.headline: Staff software engineer at Dremio
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer with nine years of experience building CI/CD systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, and developer tooling.
 
At Dremio, I focus on improving the reliability and efficiency of the software delivery process across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. I’ve built pipelines that deploy Kubernetes-based environments on demand, implemented infrastructure as code, improved monitoring and incident response, and developed an AI agent that investigates build failures across multiple platforms.
 
Before Dremio, I led Tableau Prep’s build and infrastructure team at Salesforce. I managed a team of five engineers, owned release processes, and built tools that reduced dependency-update work from months to days while improving the speed and reliability of software delivery.
 
I enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems, eliminating manual work, and creating systems that help engineering teams move faster without sacrificing reliability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (DevOps)
positions.description:
Lead improvements to Dremio’s CI/CD, cloud-development, and build infrastructure, with a focus on reliability, automation, and developer productivity.
● Built an AI-assisted system that investigates build failures across multiple platforms and helps engineers identify likely causes more quickly.
● Designed the stable-daas promotion pipeline, validating builds through DaaS deployment and automated testing before synchronizing stable Git tags across repositories.
● Increased Dremio-as-a-Service (DaaS) pipeline stability by identifying recurring failure modes and implementing targeted automation to reduce avoidable build and deployment failures.
● Led investigations and improvements across Jenkins, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, including cloud-capacity and workload-scheduling issues.
● Replaced recurring manual CI troubleshooting with reusable automation, operational tooling, and documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (DevOps)
positions.description:
Enhancing Dremio's cloud infrastructure while ensuring performance and reliability. Responsible for streamlining operations and enhancing team efficiency.
● Built pipelines to deploy Kubernetes-based Dremio instances to all major cloud platforms on demand, supporting QA testing and other operational needs
● Created and maintained a Kubernetes-based Dremio server that automatically deploys the latest code, enabling testing and integration of new features
● Improved the on-call experience with Prometheus alerts, enabling more effective system monitoring and incident response.
● Developed a reusable OSX node for Jenkins with Packer and AWS, streamlining workflows and increasing efficiency.
● Spearheaded the implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices for our Google Cloud Platform account using Terraform
positions.insights: Kubernetes, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led the build and infrastructure team at Tableau Prep, consistently delivering successful outcomes and overseeing end-to-end completion of major projects. 
● Efficiently managed the release process as the Release Manager for Tableau Prep, ensuring smooth and successful software releases.
● Innovated and created new tools to simplify third-party library management, resulting in a significant reduction of required update time from months to days.
● Implemented a streamlined branching model, reducing developer mistakes and enabling faster new release snapshots.
● Provided leadership and direction to a high-performing team of five, fostering a collaborative and successful work environment.
positions.insights: Data Analysis, Python (Programming Language) and +8 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (DevOps)
positions.description:
Fostering heightened business performance by spearheading the development and implementation of new servers and automated solutions. To empower the team, I strategically organized and conducted regular training sessions, bolstering staff effectiveness.
● Successfully launched a new web server, providing developers with a seamless and user-friendly method to track commit status, enhancing collaboration and version control.
● Significantly streamlined operations by automating essential tasks, such as generating daily test server status reports and managing password rotations, thereby optimizing efficiency and resource utilization.

positions.title: Software Engineer (DevOps)
positions.description:
Harnessing my software engineering and development expertise to introduce novel tools and processes, contributing to improved workflows and outcomes.
● Demonstrated exceptional leadership skills by being appointed as the Scrum Lead, efficiently guiding and facilitating all scrum events, ensuring seamless collaboration and project delivery.

positions.title: Build Engineer
positions.description:
Denali Advanced Integration contract
I provided invaluable expertise in troubleshooting code breaks, bugs, and other issues, while meticulously monitoring pipelines for Microsoft Office.
● Enhanced team productivity by developing innovative tools using C#, .NET Core, and Python scripts, streamlining processes and enabling more efficient workflows.

positions.title: Area Sales Manager
positions.description:
As an Area Sales Manager, I was accountable for the distribution and sales of Red Bull to all convenience stores in northern King County—an area responsible for selling over $1.3 million worth of products annually.
• Demonstrated problem-solving skills by promptly troubleshooting minor equipment failures and resolving order discrepancies, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted operations.
• Earned recognition as the Top Area Sales Manager in King County for 2016, reflecting my commitment to achieving outstanding sales results and exceeding targets.
• Served as Vice Chairman of the Safety Committee, playing an instrumental role in reducing Columbia's accident rate to an all-time low, fostering a culture of safety and well-being.
